title: Layered Audio inheritance and migration
summary: Layered Audio already owns useful generic ML/tensor contracts and execution-state rules. ooRexx ML adopts those semantics while avoiding class collisions during staged ownership migration.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Semantic materials are distinct from transient runtime tensors.
Foreign/native execution does not own model meaning.
Checkpoint values crossing machine boundaries must be detachable/value-only.
Existing Audio v0.21 generic class names must not be duplicated into a co-loaded package without migration.
procedure: Use MLModelDefinition/MLTensorContract adapters against Audio-like objects in v0.1.
Move generic contracts upward only in a coordinated Audio rebase.
